name: External browser type
description: Types text into the temporary Peer-managed Chromium session, optionally focusing a CSS selector first.

localizedDescription.zh-CN: 向临时 Peer 托管 Chromium 输入文本，可先按 CSS 选择器聚焦目标。
localizedDescription.en-US: Types text into the temporary Peer-managed Chromium session, optionally focusing a CSS selector first.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector to focus before typing. Supports frame:N prefix.

clear.description: Clear the target field before typing. Defaults to false.

submit.description: Press Enter after typing. Defaults to false.
